observed_motion_screen.visibility_definition: Fraction of frames with projected mean hand landmark inside recorded RGB image; appearance additionally checked on all80frames.
observed_motion_screen.selected_by: Visual review: both hands manipulating same held cloth; early onset before left hand fully visible and late cloth drop excluded.

inference.semantics: Observed input samples follow the eight-second recorded clip. Only the anchor at clip4.0s is passed through the base policy; its single15-pose future chunk is distinct from later recorded observations.
inference.mask: Fresh SAM3 segmentation of the manipulated white cloth held between both hands; exact private staged binary mask supplied to policy and checked against every saved input. Original cached annotation was zero.

timing.input_posters: All input posters use clip frame 40 / raw 403 / preprocessed 381.
timing.interpolation: Saved 15 predictions are exact model results. Video linearly interpolates retargeted joint angles and root translation, with SLERP root rotations. No motion amplification. First/final poses held at boundaries.
timing.prediction_posters: prediction-chunk.png is first future pose; prediction-chunk-final.png is last. Both derive from the same clip4.0s model inference.

mask_generation.prompt: Whole held fabric instance; text masks supply approximate boxes, then box/point-guided instance segmentation retains colored stripe and excludes sleeves/hands.
mask_generation.object_identity: The complete white fabric item manipulated between both hands, including colored stripe. Excludes worn cuffs, hands, wall and chair.
mask_generation.staging: Only the 80 selected observation mask frames replaced in a private cache. Original source dataset untouched. The exact staged mask is fed into policy inference.

semantics.rgb: Original recorded RGB with fixed spatial crop.
semantics.mask: Fresh SAM3 segmentation of the manipulated white cloth held between both hands. Text-grounded rough boxes followed by SAM3 interactive box/point-guided instance segmentation. Full-resolution binary masks are resized nearest-neighbor to 160x120; these exact masks are supplied to the actual policy. Binary display MP4 is compressed, while PNG/NPZ masks preserve exact binary values.
semantics.cloud: Saved measured stereo-depth points; no synthesized geometry or additional depth inference. Before/after differ by recorded calibrated hand mask exclusion.
semantics.sampled: Exactly 5000 policy input points saved per observation; display uses the common 0.07–0.55m foreground depth crop, so visible count is lower. semantics.proprio: Recorded human hand landmarks retargeted to real Wuji meshes. This is derived robot visualization, not recorded robot joint sensing.
semantics.prediction: One genuine unadapted base-policy chunk conditioned on freeze-anchor observations and fresh held-cloth mask, retargeted to Wuji; one opaque hand pair, no ghost stack.
semantics.coordinates: All geometry shown in fixed freeze-anchor RGB frame in metres, with one fixed virtual camera; RGB/mask use the same fixed pixel crop.
semantics.transparency: WebM VP9 alpha and PNG RGBA for hand/cloud/object assets. RGB and binary-mask H264 videos are opaque.

motion_metrics.coordinates: Observed positions in world frame; prediction and recorded future in fixed freeze-anchor RGB frame. Rigid transformations preserve these distances.

motion_interpretation: Movement metrics describe this recorded example; they are not accuracy, task success, or robot execution scores.

scene_manifest.json.coordinates: All cloud views transformed into fixed freeze-anchor RGB coordinates, removing head motion.
scene_manifest.json.mask: Fresh SAM3 mask of the white cloth held between both hands, resized nearest-neighbor to 160x120 and supplied to policy. Overlay, cutout and binary display derive from the identical full-resolution mask. Binary before H264 High/yuv420p encoding.
scene_manifest.json.hand_removal: Original stereo-left annotation, calibrated world-to-stereo projection and 4-pixel dilation.
scene_manifest.json.sampling: All 5000 exact sampled input points are saved; display applies the same 0.07–0.55m foreground depth crop as dense views to omit the distant wall. This crop affects visualization only, not policy input.

motion_metrics.json.coordinates: Observed positions in world frame; prediction and recorded future in fixed freeze-anchor RGB frame. Rigid transformations preserve these distances.

inference_manifest.json.semantics: Observed input samples follow the eight-second recorded clip. Only the anchor at clip4.0s is passed through the base policy; its single15-pose future chunk is distinct from later recorded observations.
inference_manifest.json.mask: Fresh SAM3 segmentation of the manipulated white cloth held between both hands; exact private staged binary mask supplied to policy and checked against every saved input. Original cached annotation was zero.

observed_motion_screen.visibility_definition: Fraction of frames with projected mean hand landmark inside recorded RGB image; appearance additionally checked on all80frames.
observed_motion_screen.selected_by: Visual review: both hands manipulating same held cloth; early onset before left hand fully visible and late cloth drop excluded.

timing.input_posters: All input posters use clip frame 40 / raw 403 / preprocessed 381.
timing.interpolation: Saved 15 predictions are exact model results. Video linearly interpolates retargeted joint angles and root translation, with SLERP root rotations. No motion amplification. First/final poses held at boundaries.
timing.prediction_posters: prediction-chunk.png is first future pose; prediction-chunk-final.png is last. Both derive from the same clip4.0s model inference.

semantics.rgb: Original recorded RGB with fixed spatial crop.
semantics.mask: Fresh SAM3 segmentation of the manipulated white cloth held between both hands. Text-grounded rough boxes followed by SAM3 interactive box/point-guided instance segmentation. Explicit point corrections on frames 8, 61 and 73; tiny detached components removed. All 80 masks visually reviewed before inference. Original cached object annotation is zero. Full-resolution binary masks are resized nearest-neighbor to 160x120; these exact masks are supplied to the actual policy. Binary display MP4 is compressed, while PNG/NPZ masks preserve exact binary values.
semantics.cloud: Saved measured stereo-depth points; no synthesized geometry or additional depth inference. Before/after differ by recorded calibrated hand mask exclusion.
semantics.sampled: Exactly 5000 policy input points saved per observation; display uses the common 0.07–0.55m foreground depth crop, so visible count is lower. This omits the distant wall for presentation; the full 5000 points are the actual policy input. The full freeze-anchor sample is included in anchor_scene.npz.
semantics.proprio: Recorded human hand landmarks retargeted to real Wuji meshes. This is derived robot visualization, not recorded robot joint sensing.
semantics.prediction: One genuine unadapted base-policy chunk conditioned on freeze-anchor observations and fresh held-cloth mask, retargeted to Wuji; one opaque hand pair, no ghost stack.
semantics.coordinates: All geometry shown in fixed freeze-anchor RGB frame in metres, with one fixed virtual camera; RGB/mask use the same fixed pixel crop.
semantics.transparency: WebM VP9 alpha and PNG RGBA for hand/cloud/object assets. RGB and binary-mask H264 videos are opaque.

motion.coordinates: Observed positions in world frame; prediction and recorded future in fixed freeze-anchor RGB frame. Rigid transformations preserve these distances.

packaging.metadata: Final source metadata is preserved recursively with private absolute paths and their account names redacted. Media and numeric archives are copied byte-for-byte; camera numbers are unchanged.
